geometry: 2D plane strain rectangle; 70mm width x 140mm height defaults; unit thickness
planeStrainConvention: 2D: F_zz=1; sigma_zz evolves constitutively; qJ2 and qtriaxial differ; not axisymmetric
stressConvention: compression positive CSV; native tension positive Cauchy stress
axialStrainConvention: MPM: prescribed platen engineering strain; separate measured particle-domain extent diagnostic; homogeneous: computed F_yy
plasticStrainConvention: VM plastic_strain CSV column unavailable; mc-plastic-strain-native is accumulated sqrt(3 J2(dev delta epsilon_p)), 1.5 times conventional equivalent plastic strain; no PDF strain conversion
platenWorkConvention: rectified added platen force work, with cell-pressure work separate; not signed energy closure
yieldConvention: VM max_yield_excess CSV column unavailable; mc-yield-residual-kirchhoff-pa=k*tau_max-tau_min-2*c*sqrt(k), k=(1+sin(phi))/(1-sin(phi)), tau=J*sigma_Cauchy, native tension-positive; signed Pa; stored native yield-function is trial f
drainage: no pore fluid or pore pressure; no true CU effective-stress path
deformationSource: native 2D plane-strain grid/particle momentum solve with full 3D constitutive state

materialDiagnosticsFields.name: mc-plastic-strain-native
materialDiagnosticsFields.definition: accumulated sqrt(3 J2(dev delta epsilon_p)); shared native plastic state, not VM inheritance

materialDiagnosticsFields.name: mc-yield-residual-kirchhoff-pa
materialDiagnosticsFields.definition: signed corrected MC residual, native tension-positive Kirchhoff stress

materialDiagnosticsFields.name: mc-trial-yield-kirchhoff-pa
materialDiagnosticsFields.definition: stored trial yield value; not corrected residual
